name: McEval
description: McEval is a massively multilingual code benchmark covering 40 programming languages with 16,000 test samples. It evaluates code understanding, completion, and generation tasks across diverse languages, addressing the lack of multilingual diversity in existing benchmarks.
typical_sota_score: varies by language and task; overall top models typically achieve roughly 40–80% (pass@1 equivalent depending on language and k)
reputation: A recent multilingual code benchmark that is gaining attention for broad language coverage, but is not yet as established as the most widely used code benchmarks.
notes: Includes a multilingual instruction corpus (McEval-Instruct) and supports evaluation of open-source and closed-source models across many languages.
